annotations.title: Fox Davidson Lending Index (UK bridging and commercial lending data)

description: Return the Fox Davidson Lending Index: quarterly UK bridging loan and commercial mortgage data from completed deals and borrower enquiries. Covers median days from application to completion, loan sizes, loan to value, purpose, share of regulated bridges, owner-occupier share, enquiry demand by type and month, a comparison with the wider market, and findings that can be quoted with credit. From Fox Davidson, whole of market UK mortgage brokers authorised and regulated by the FCA (FRN 1056214).
